definitions.explanation: a written document specifying goods or services to be purchased

examples.japanese: {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}を{送|おく}る。
{注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}に{必要事項|ひつようじこう}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in the required information on the order form.

examples.japanese: {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}を{受|う}け{取|と}り{次第|しだい}、{発送|はっそう}します。
examples.english: We will ship as soon as we receive the order form.

notes:
{注文書|ちゅうもんしょ} is a formal document used to place orders for goods or services.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}を{送|おく}る: to send an order form
- {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}を{作成|さくせい}する: to prepare an order form
- {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}に{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill out an order form
- {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive an order form

WORD FORMATION:
Combines {注文|ちゅうもん} (order) + {書|しょ} (document). The suffix {〜書|しょ} appears in many document names.

RELATED BUSINESS DOCUMENTS:
- {発注書|はっちゅうしょ}: purchase order (more formal)
- {見積書|みつもりしょ}: quotation/estimate
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}: invoice
- {納品書|のうひんしょ}: delivery slip
- {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}: receipt
